items.title: FIFA presses ahead with private investment plan despite opposition
items.description: FIFA vows to continue with consultations on a proposed private investment plan despite industry pledges to boycott the World Cup if the sale continues.

items.title: Hobart deputy mayor snack matter referred to police
items.description: The Hobart city council has voted to refer a matter concerning its deputy lord mayor and the taking home of snacks to Tasmania Police and the director of local government.

items.title: Politics were the focus, but Bluey stole the show at Garma
items.description: The first day of the nation's biggest Indigenous gathering was political, but the must-see guest was not a member of parliament.

items.title: Live: Re-run 1,500 T54 race sees a different Australian win bronze
items.description: Australia's cyclists will look to build on their successful opening day at the velodrome, while Lachie Kennedy and Torrie Lewis eye dual 200m gold on the track. Follow live.

items.title: Gina Rinehart puts ABC on notice over Race Around the World episode
items.description: Hancock Prospecting has formally placed ABC Chair Kim Williams AM, Deputy Chair Lisa Caffery and Managing Director Hugh Marks on notice and foreshadowed possible legal action.

items.title: NDIS provider pockets $1 million after incorrectly billing participants
items.description: Some NDIS service providers have been referred to the ACCC as the government reveals thousands have been engaging in questionable billing practices, including using funds to pay for float tanks and golf lessons.

items.title: Funeral held for 'bright spark' 13-year-old allegedly murdered by teen boy
items.description: Hundreds of mourners gather in Victoria's west to say farewell to 13-year-old Layla Jeffrey after her remains were found earlier this month.

items.title: Six Fijians found clinging to planks of wood after 36 hours lost at sea
items.description: Six Fiji health workers survive a harrowing ordeal at sea thanks to a former classmate of one of the survivors.

items.title: Live: Late first-half sin bin gives Storm the edge over Bulldogs in vital clash
items.description: The Melbourne Storm will be without halfback Jahrome Hughes for tonight's vital round 22 clash against the Canterbury-Bankstown Bulldogs. Follow live.

items.title: Trump's Hamas plan a 'huge moment' that raises a lot of questions
items.description: Middle East analysts are sceptical Hamas will willingly lay down its weapons and that Israel will totally withdraw from Gaza.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
